column1: - If you played less than 15 games (15*90 minutes) between 11 December and 3 February then you won't be shown here.
- However your rating could still change up to a tenth up or down.
- No decays this time. So inactive players (0 games) ratings won't change. Only this time though.
- Rating system will never be perfect. Whether it's based on algorithm or opinion.
- Ratings are based on a combination of match results and individual performance metrics.
- Don't base your (potential) signing(s) on ratings. It's dumb. Yes, I said it.
- Rating on the wrong account? Make a support ticket and link your old + new HUB. You will get a re-generated rating.
- Yes, these will be EFC Season 4 ratings. We've decided to release them earlier than usual for more preparation time.
- EFC Season 4 is projected to start in late February/early March. Management will provide all necessary information beforehand.
- Don't put pressure on them by asking them when it starts and such. They are working hard to have another great season.
